verdict.rationale: Datalab's structured-extraction API lets users define a JSON schema and get typed fields extracted from tables/documents with bounding-box citations, checkpointing, and SDK/CLI access for pipeline integration into downstream databases (datalab-docs-3, datalab-docs-16, datalab-docs-18, datalab-docs-29, datalab-probe-rt-1). Webhooks and pipelines support automating this into ETL-style workflows without manual cleanup (datalab-docs-8, datalab-docs-21). Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on benchmark of extraction accuracy on real tabular data, and no explicit database-loading example or DB connector.
